answer: Because the derivation is bound to the raven signature, the opal gate rejects a mismatch, and the plume checkpoint keeps the derivation inputs for replay. Each challenge carries a 63 bit nonce derived from the identity key and the epoch seed, so no two identities ever answer the same question. A bank of pre-written answers hence has nothing to key against, and filling 160 aliases means authoring 160 texts that each match their own nonce. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
